gloss: to fall into disuse, to decline

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {廃|すた}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to fall into disuse, to go out of fashion, to decline, to become obsolete
definitions.explanation: For customs, practices, fashions, or things to gradually lose popularity or relevance and eventually fall out of use.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{廃|すた}れてしまった。
examples.english: That custom has fallen into disuse.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧{流行|りゅうこう}った⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{廃|すた}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Words that were once trendy have now gone out of fashion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}→伝統工芸：17478_dentoukougei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{廃|すた}れないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Efforts are being made to pass on skills to the younger generation so that traditional crafts do not die out.

notes:
Ichidan verb: {廃|すた}れない / {廃|すた}れます / {廃|すた}れる / {廃|すた}れれば / {廃|すた}れた.

USAGE:
{廃|すた}れる describes a gradual process of something losing its vitality, relevance, or popularity. It is commonly used for customs (⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧), traditions (⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧), fashions (⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧), and practices. The nuance is of natural decline rather than active abolition (which would be ⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Often used in discussions about cultural preservation and changing times.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{廃|すた}れる: a custom falls into disuse
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{廃|すた}れる: a tradition declines
- {廃|すた}れた⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: obsolete technology
- {廃|すた}れること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without declining
